number.q.title: Do you already have a WhatsApp Business number?
number.notSure.body: This is the number your customers will message. It's different from your personal WhatsApp.
number.where.title: Where is that number used today?
number.personal.title: This number is on your personal WhatsApp
number.personal.warning: To use this number with WaFlow, you must remove it from your personal WhatsApp first. You will lose WhatsApp on that number. We recommend using a separate business number.
number.personal.how: In WhatsApp, go to Settings, then Account, then Delete my account. Your chat history on that number will be lost, so back up your chats first. It can take up to 3 minutes before the number can be connected to WaFlow.
number.personal.ack: I understand I will lose WhatsApp on this number.
number.bizapp.title: This number is on the WhatsApp Business app
number.bizapp.body: You may be able to keep using the app and WaFlow on the same number. Meta decides this when you connect, so we can't promise it will be offered for your number.
number.bizapp.changes: If Meta offers it, here is what changes:
number.bizapp.c1: Update the WhatsApp Business app to the latest version first.
number.bizapp.c2: Some app features stop working on that number, for example broadcast lists.
number.bizapp.c3: Open the WhatsApp Business app at least every 2 weeks, or the connection can drop.
number.bizapp.c4: Messages sent through WaFlow are charged by Meta to your own Meta account.
number.bizapp.move: Move this number to WaFlow instead
number.migrate.title: Move this number to WaFlow
number.migrate.body: To move the number, you first delete the WhatsApp account on it. Your chat history on that number will be lost, so back up your chats first. It can take up to 3 minutes before the number can be connected to WaFlow.
number.migrate.noCoexist: Meta doesn't offer to keep the app on this number.
number.landline.title: Meta will call this number to verify it
number.landline.body: Be near the phone and answer the call. When Meta asks, choose "Call me" instead of a text message. The line must accept calls from abroad, with call forwarding and automatic menus turned off. Extensions don't work.
number.getone.title: You need a number that can get a text or a call
number.getone.body: It can be a new mobile SIM or a landline. It must not already be used on WhatsApp.
number.getone.t1: Buy a SIM from STC, Mobily or Zain, or get a landline.
number.getone.t2: Keep the SIM in a phone, or keep the line active.
number.getone.t3: Register it in your business's name where your operator asks for it.
number.getone.t4: Check the latest rules with your operator or the Saudi telecom regulator.
number.getone.help: Ask WaFlow to help me get a number
number.help.title: We can help you choose a number
number.help.done: Thanks. We'll contact you by email. We can't buy a number for you, but we'll help you choose one.
number.help.already: You've already asked. We'll be in touch.
number.paused.title: Take your time
number.paused.body: Your progress is saved. We'll email you a reminder. Come back when your number is ready.
number.paused.badge: Paused. Come back when your number is ready.

connect.appSteps: In the Facebook window, choose to connect your existing WhatsApp Business app. Enter your number. WhatsApp will show a code, and the app will get a message: tap Connect, choose whether to share your chat history, then enter the code.
connect.landlineHint: Meta will call this number. Answer the call and choose "Call me" when asked.
connect.inapp: You're in an app's built-in browser, where the Facebook window often doesn't open. Open this page in Chrome or Safari.

approvals.verification.waiting: Meta is checking your business. This can take days. You can keep going.
approvals.verification.needs: Meta needs documents from you to verify your business. Open Meta's security settings and follow the steps there.

approvals.name.reason.NAME_FORMAT_UNACCE: The name format isn't accepted. Avoid special characters and all capital letters.

approvals.name.sent: Sent to Meta. We'll tell you when it's decided.
approvals.name.limit: You can change a display name up to 10 times in 30 days.

errors.BILLING_PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't open the payment page. Please try again or contact us.

errors.CONNECT_NOT_CONFIGURED: Connecting WhatsApp isn't available yet on our side. Please contact us and we'll sort it out.
errors.ENCRYPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: Connecting WhatsApp isn't available yet on our side. Please contact us and we'll sort it out.
errors.CONNECT_IN_PROGRESS: We're already connecting your WhatsApp. Please wait a moment.
errors.CONNECT_ATTEMPT_INVALID: This connection attempt expired. Please start again.
errors.CONNECT_CODE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED: The sign-in took too long, so Meta's code expired. Please try once more.
errors.CONNECT_WABA_MISMATCH: That's a different WhatsApp Business account from the one connected before. To switch accounts, disconnect first.
errors.CONNECT_NUMBER_IN_USE_BY_OTHER_AC: This number is already connected to another WaFlow account. Use a different number, or ask us for help.
errors.CONNECT_NUMBER_REGISTERED_ELSEWHE: This number is already used on another WhatsApp account. Remove it from that account first, wait about 15 minutes, then try again. Or use a different number.
errors.CONNECT_VERIFICATION_FAILED: We couldn't verify your number. Open the window again and choose a text message or a call to get a new code. If you asked for several codes, wait a while before trying again.
errors.CONNECT_CANCELLED: No problem, connect whenever you're ready.
errors.CONNECT_NO_FACEBOOK_ACCOUNT: You need a Facebook account to use WhatsApp Business. Once you can log in, come back here.
errors.CONNECT_COEXISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Meta doesn't offer to keep the app on this number.
errors.CONNECT_REGISTER_RATE_LIMITED: WhatsApp limits how often a number can be set up. Please wait a few hours and try again.
errors.CONNECT_PARTIAL: WhatsApp is connected, but we're still finishing a few things.
errors.CONNECT_AMBIGUOUS_WABA: We found more than one WhatsApp Business account and couldn't tell which one to use. Our team will help.
errors.META_UNREACHABLE: We couldn't reach Meta. Check your connection and try again.
errors.META_ERROR: Meta returned an error. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.META_TOKEN_REVOKED: WhatsApp access was removed or expired. Reconnect to continue.
errors.META_PERMISSION_MISSING: WaFlow doesn't have all the permissions it needs. Reconnect and accept all the permissions.
errors.META_RATE_LIMITED: Meta asked us to slow down. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.META_NOT_CONFIGURED: Connecting WhatsApp isn't available yet on our side. Please contact us and we'll sort it out.
errors.TEMPLATE_LIMIT_REACHED: This account has reached the limit for message templates. Contact us to continue.
errors.TEMPLATE_REJECTED: Meta didn't approve this message. You can try again.
errors.TEST_RATE_LIMITED: You've sent several tests. Please wait a while before sending another.
errors.TEST_NO_APPROVED_TEMPLATE: Your first message template isn't approved yet. We'll tell you when it is.
errors.TEST_RECIPIENT_OPTED_OUT: That phone number has opted out of messages, so we can't send to it. Use a different phone.
errors.TEST_PHONE_INVALID: Enter a phone number with the country code, different from your business number.
errors.TEST_NUMBER_LIMIT: You've used the test numbers available for your account. Contact us if you need another.
errors.ONB_NETWORK: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ONB_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again. If it keeps happening, tap Need help.
errors.ONB_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't load your setup progress. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ONB_SDK_BLOCKED: The Facebook window couldn't load. An ad blocker, a privacy setting or a weak connection can cause this. Turn it off for this page or try another browser, then try again.
errors.ONB_SDK_TIMEOUT: The Facebook window is taking too long to load. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ONB_POPUP_BLOCKED: Your browser blocked the Facebook window. Allow pop-ups for this page, then tap Connect again.
errors.ONB_IN_APP_BROWSER: You're in an app's built-in browser, where the Facebook window often doesn't open. Open this page in Chrome or Safari.
errors.ONB_CODE_HANDOFF_SLOW: That took too long and Meta's code expired. Please connect again.
errors.ONB_IMPORT_TOO_MANY: This file has more than 5,000 customers. Please split it into smaller files.
errors.ONB_IMPORT_BAD_FILE: We couldn't read this file. Save it as a CSV file and try again.
errors.ONB_IMPORT_NO_ROWS: We couldn't find any customers in this file.
